Special Council Meeting - CEO Recruitment Process - 24 February 2026

Tuesday, February 24, 2026 - 04:30 PM

In accordance with Regulation 14I(7) & (8) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, the Shire of York advises that unfortunately it was not possible for a recording to be made of this Special Council Meeting using the Shire’s normal recording technology, as no sound file was recorded. Therefore, there was no improvised recording made. It was not reasonably practicable to make an improvised recording as Officers were unaware the recording of the meeting was not occurring at the time the meeting was held.  The lack of a sound file was not identified until after the meeting while Officers were checking the sound file for record management and publication purposes.

    In accordance with Regulation 12(4) of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996 notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held at 4.30pm on Tuesday 24 February 2026 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York.

    The purpose of the meeting is for Council to consider:

    1. Confidential Report - Job Description for the Chief Executive Officer

    The meeting will be closed to the public during consideration of the report in accordance with Section 5.23(2)(b) of the Local Government Act 1995 as it deals with a matter relating to the recruitment or employment of the Chief Executive Officer.

    The agenda will be available on the Shire’s website.

    Anneke Birleson

    ACTING EXECUTIVE MANAGER CORPORATE & COMMUNITY SERVICES
    (on behalf of the Temporary Chief Executive Officer)

    View Meeting Details

    Annual Electors Meeting - 3 February 2026

    Tuesday, February 3, 2026 - 06:30 PM

    The Annual Electors Meeting will be held on:

    Date:                Tuesday 3 February 2026

    Time:               6.30pm

    Place:               York CRC Function Room

    The order of business for the meeting will be to accept the 2024/25 Annual Report and any other general business.

    The Annual Electors Meeting is an opportunity for Council to present the 2024/25 Annual Report and for members of the public to ask any questions about the Report and Shire activities for the previous financial year.

    To ensure the most accurate and informed responses can be provided to your questions, please submit your question(s) in writing by no later than Friday 30 January 2026.  Questions can be emailed to records@york.wa.gov.au (preferred), posted to PO Box 22, York WA 6302 or hand delivered to the Shire Administration Office at 1 Joaquina Street, York.

    We look forward to seeing you at the Annual Electors Meeting.

    View Meeting Details

    Special Council Meeting - Recruitment of a Senior Officer - Executive Manager Infrastructure & Development Services

    Tuesday, January 27, 2026 - 04:00 PM

    In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the Local Government Act 1995 notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 27 January 2026 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 4.00pm.

    The purpose of the meeting is to consider the:

    1. Appointment of a Senior Officer - Executive Manager Infrastructure & Development Services

    The meeting will be closed to the public during consideration of the report in accordance with Sections 5.23(a) and (c) the Local Government Act 1995 as it deals with a matter affecting an employee and a contract which may be entered into by the local government.

    View Meeting Details

    Special Council Meeting - 13 January 2026 - CEO Recruitment Process

    Tuesday, January 13, 2026 - 03:30 PM

    A Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 13 January 2026 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 3.30pm.

    The purpose of the meeting is to consider the:

    1. Appointment of the Independent Member to the CEO Selection Panel
    2. Appointment of HR Facilitator – RFQ10-2526 – Provision of Consultancy Services to Facilitate the Recruitment and Selection of a Chief Executive Officer

    The meeting will be closed to the public during consideration of those reports in accordance with Sections 5.23(a) and (c) of the Local Government Act 1995 as it deals with the personal affairs of any person (Item 8.1) and a contract which may be entered into by the local government (Item 8.2).

Special Council Meeting - CEO Recruitment Process

Tuesday, December 2, 2025 - 08:00 AM

In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the Local Government Act 1995 notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 2 December 2025 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 8.00am.

The purpose of the meeting is to consider the:

  1. Process and Timeline of the Recruitment and Selection Process for the Chief Executive Officer
  2. Appointment of Elected Members to the CEO Selection Panel, Selection Panel Terms of Reference and Expression of Interest for Independent Member
  3. Request for Quote - Consultancy Services to Facilitate the Recruitment and Selection of a Chief Executive Officer

The meeting is closed to the public in accordance with Section 5.23(a) of the Local Government Act 1995 as it deals with a matter affecting an employee.

Annual Electors Meeting - 18 February 2025

Tuesday, February 18, 2025 - 06:30 PM

The Shire of York invites residents to attend the Annual Electors Meeting.

This is your opportunity to:

  • Learn about the Shire's achievements, projects and financial performance over the past year by viewing the 2023/24 Annual Report
  • Ask questions and share feedback with Councillors.

The 2023/24 Annual Report is available HERE.

To submit a question to be answered at the Annual Electors Meeting please contact Vanessa at the Shire Administration on records@york.wa.gov.au (preferred), or phone 9641 0500, or drop into the Shire Administration during normal business hours.

We look forward to seeing you there!

A Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 28 January 2025 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 5.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is to:

  1. Consider adoption of the 2023/24 Annual Report and set the date for the Annual Electors Meeting
  2. Consideration of Sponsorship Acquittals

The Special Council Meeting is open to members of the public and those interested are encouraged to attend.

Date:                Tuesday 21 May 2024

Time:               6.00pm

Place:               Lesser Hall, York Town Hall, York

 

The order of business for the meeting will be to accept the 2022/23 Annual Report and any other general business. A copy of the 2022/23 Annual Report is available HERE.

The Annual Electors Meeting is an opportunity for Council to present the 2022/23 Annual Report and for members of the public to ask any questions about the Report and Shire activities for the previous financial year.

To ensure the most accurate and informed responses can be provided to your questions, please submit your question(s) in writing prior to the meeting.  Questions can be emailed to records@york.wa.gov.au, posted to PO Box 22, York WA 6302 or hand delivered to the Shire Administration Office at 1 Joaquina Street, York.

We look forward to seeing you at the Annual Electors Meeting.

In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the Local Government Act 1995 notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 29 August 2023 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 5.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is to adopt the 2023/24 Annual Budget and associated financial reports.

The Special Council Meeting is open to members of the public and those interested are encouraged to attend.

Special Council Meeting - Annual Report & Annual Electors Meeting - 15 Feb 2022

Tuesday, February 15, 2022 - 04:30 PM

A Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 15 February 2022 in the Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall, Joaquina Street, York commencing at 4.30pm.

The purpose of the meetings is to receive and adopt the 2020/21 Annual Report and Financial Statements and consider the Findings identified during the Interim and Final Audit.

The Special Meeting is open to members of the public and those interested are encouraged to attend.

Special Electors Meeting

Tuesday, April 12, 2022 - 05:30 PM

A Special Meeting of Electors (the Meeting) of the Shire of York will be held at the Town Hall, Cnr Avon Terrace & Joaquina Street, York commencing at 5.30pm on Tuesday 12 April 2022 to consider a request signed by 165 electors to discuss the following:

  1. The effect of mandatory vaccination on electors, ratepayers, residents and business in the district;
  2. The effect of mandatory vaccination on the local government’s affairs and the performance of the local government’s functions; and
  3. Motions to be voted on for an advocacy position against mandatory vaccination for the Council to consider adopting to provide leadership and guidance to the community in the district.

Electors and ratepayers are invited to attend. Registration will be available from 5.00pm.

Councillors and staff welcome your questions regarding the Notice of Meeting. To enable any questions to be answered at the Meeting, questions are to be submitted on the Special Meeting of Electors Question Form, available from the Shire’s website or Administration Office. Completed Question Forms can be returned via email to records@york.wa.gov.au or to the Shire Administration Office and should be received at least two (2) days prior to the meeting to enable an appropriate response to be prepared.

Any queries in relation to the Meeting can be directed to Vanessa Green, Council & Executive Support Officer, on (08) 9641 0500 or records@york.wa.gov.au.

CHRIS LINNELL
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Special Electors Meeting - 20 July 2021

Tuesday, July 20, 2021 - 05:00 PM

NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF ELECTORS

 A Special Meeting of Electors (the Meeting) of the Shire of York will be held at the Town Hall, Cnr Avon Terrace & Joaquina Street, York commencing at 5.00pm on Tuesday 20 July 2021 to consider a request signed by 121 electors to discuss the following:

"Defer any further discussion on the transaction to outsource management of the York Recreation Community Centre (YRCC) and Forrest Oval Precinct (FOP) until-

  1. Shire of York to prepare a business plan for the disposal (sale or lease) of the YRCC and FOP to be provided to the community for consultation.
  2. Provide a four-week period for the community to review and discuss the business plan with the Shire of York executive.
  3. The Shire of York to provide a breakdown of the actual operating costs and revenue separately of the YRCC and FOP for the past three years and the estimated forecast for the next three years."

Electors and ratepayers are invited to attend. Registration will be available from 4.30pm.

The Elected Members and staff welcome your questions regarding the Notice of Meeting. To enable any questions to be answered at the Meeting, questions are to be submitted on the Special Meeting of Electors Question Form, available below or from the Administration Office. Completed Question Forms can be returned via email to records@york.wa.gov.au or to the Shire Administration Office and should be received by 4.30pm on Friday 16 July 2021 to enable an informed response to be prepared.

Any queries in relation to the Meeting can be directed to Vanessa Green, Council & Executive Support Officer, on (08) 9641 0500 or records@york.wa.gov.au.

CHRIS LINNELL
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Special Council Meeting - 2021/22 Budget Adoption

Thursday, July 8, 2021 - 05:00 PM

NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

In accordance with Section 5.5(2) of the Local Government Act 1995, notice is hereby given that a Special Meeting of Council will be held on Thursday 8 July 2021 in the Council Chambers, York Town Hall, Avon Terrace, York commencing at 5.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is to adopt the 2021/22 Budget.

The meeting is open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. The meeting agenda is available on the Shire’s website and from the Shire Administration Office.

Chris Linnell
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

Council Meetings

Council meetings are held on the fourth Tuesday of the month (except January), commencing at 5.00pm. Audit & Risk Committee Meetings are held quarterly on the second Tuesday of the month commencing at 3.00pm.  The exception to this is December resulting in a shortened timeframe due to the Christmas period where the meeting cycle is bought forward one week resulting in the Council Meeting being held on the third Tuesday. Council and Audit & Risk Committee meetings are held in Council Chambers, First Floor York Town Hall.

Any changes are advertised through the website, the Shire's social media and noticeboards. Where timing allows notice is also published in the local newspaper and/or the Shire's e-Newsletter.

Special Council Meetings are held as required. These will also be advertised as required.

Meetings are open to the public and those interested are encouraged to attend.

Agenda Briefing

Agenda Briefings are held on the third Tuesday of the month (except January) commencing at 5.00pm in Council Chambers. The exception to this is December resulting in a shortened timeframe due to the Christmas period where the meeting cycle is bought forward one week resulting in the Agenda Briefing being held on the second Tuesday.  Agenda Briefings provide an opportunity for Councillors to ask questions or seek clarification on matters listed in the Agenda.  No debate or discussion on the Agenda reports or other topics is permitted. 

Agenda Briefings are open to the public, and while no public participation can occur, attending provides an opportunity for the public to see the decision making process of Council in action.

Public Question Time – How To Ask A Question

Public Question Time is, as the name suggests, an opportunity to ask Questions of Council. Questions may be asked at an Ordinary Council Meeting on any matter affecting Council and the Shire’s operations. Questions asked at Committee meetings are to relate to the function of that Committee. Questions submitted to Special Meetings are restricted to the subject matter of that meeting.

Each questioner is limited to two (2) questions. Statements or long preamble are not permitted. Where multiple questions are formed into one sentence or paragraph these will be separated into the individual questions.

People are to put their questions in writing or in the prescribed form and submit them to the Chief Executive Officer prior to 10 am on the business day prior to the day of the meeting. This allows for an informed response to be given at the meeting. While oral questions are permitted at a meeting, these may be Taken on Notice and the response provided in the Agenda for the next Ordinary Meeting.

Questions not answered during the meeting will be taken on notice and a response provided at a later date. The response to the question(s) will also be included in the agenda and minutes of the next Ordinary Council Meeting.

Public Question Time at Council Meetings - Policy and Proforma

Click here to download the Department of Local Government Guidelines for Council Forums

Deputations

In accordance with clause 6.9 of the Shire’s Local Government (Council Meetings) Local Law 2016, a Deputation allows for up to 2 people to address Council at an Ordinary Council Meeting and speak on any matter for a period not exceeding 10 minutes (ie if you have 2 people that could be 5mins each or 3min/7min, 1 person is 10mins).  Councillors can ask questions following the Deputation (but do not have to), which can be answered. This is done at Item 6.3 of the Council Agenda, prior to the consideration of any reports. 

If the Deputation relates to an item on the Council Agenda, when Council is considering the report/Officer’s recommendation there is no opportunity for further input from the public but is where the debate (if necessary) between Councillors occurs. A copy of the Deputation is to be provided in writing either prior to or at the meeting.  Deputations will not be included in the Meeting Minutes but are available as part of the audio recording, which can be accessed via the Past Meetings link below.

To enable a Deputation to occur, a written request addressed to the Chief Executive Officer needs to be received prior to the meeting.  Requests for Deputations can be made via email to records@york.wa.gov.au (with Request for Deputation included in the Subject Line) or hand delivered to the Shire Administration.
